name: Cortello's Riddle
summary: A parchment bearing Cortello's Riddle turns up aboard Bloodsail Buccaneer vessels along the Wild Shore. Its verse sends you toward a clue beneath an ornate bridge.

sections.title: A Buccaneer's Riddle
sections.body: Bloodsail Buccaneers anchored off Stranglethorn Vale's southern coast carry scattered notes with a rhyme. Cortello's verse describes a finely worked bridge, worn by many travelers. It lies east of Deadwind and south of Redridge. Follow the directions out of the jungle and into the marshes, where something waits below.

sections.title: The Marsh Crossing
sections.body: The verse leads beneath an ornate bridge spanning the Swamp of Sorrows. In the murky water below lies a soggy parchment with the next step in Cortello's puzzle.

faq.answer: The mystery begins with a scrap of parchment among the Bloodsail Buccaneers' fleet, anchored off the Wild Shore south of Booty Bay.

faq.q: What location is described in the riddle?
aliases: what bridge is in cortellos riddle
bridge east of deadwind south of redridge
faq.answer: The rhyme describes a well-traveled, ornate bridge in the Swamp of Sorrows, east of Deadwind Pass and south of the Redridge Mountains.

faq.q: What are you searching for beneath the bridge?
aliases: what do you find in swamp of sorrows
faq.answer: The riddle points to a hint waiting beneath the bridge.
The riddle bears Cortello's name, but the parchment says nothing more about who he was.
